paragraphs: Pinhas, a man of Havrah. They appointed him High Priest by lot, found him quarrying, and filled the quarry with gold dinars: Sifra, Emor, section 2, on the verse ‘And the priest who is greater than his brothers.’ In Tosefta Yoma 1:6: ‘a man of Ha-Birah.’ See R' Hanina ben Gamliel.
